request.text_prompt: Create original cold cinematic science-fiction game audio, approximately 60 seconds. Cinematic instrumental underscore with clear space for dialogue. Act 1: quiet wonder, slow bowed-metal harmonics and widely spaced low synth pulses. Maintain a consistent sound bed from beginning to end with slow natural variation, no opening hit or final cadence; suitable for seamless crossfaded looping. No vocals, singing, humming, speech, narration, lyrics or spoken prompt. No clipping, harsh distortion or unrelated scene sounds.
